question: The Advocate General of the State is appointed by _________.
solution:
The correct option is __**Governor.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**The Governors of states:

 
• Under Article 155, the appointment of the Governor is done by the President of India by warrant under his hand and seal.
 
• The **appointment of the Advocate General is done by the Governor**, who is the head of the State and exercises executive powers.
 
• The term of the governor's office is normally 5 years, but it can be terminated earlier.
 
• Under Article 157, the qualifications for appointment as a governor are: A Governor must
